prompt: Edit this exact LPC pixel sprite strip, not a new character design. Three equally spaced square cells in one horizontal row: down/front, right profile, back, matching reference directions and positions exactly. A male martial arts teacher with short dark brown hair, red headband, dark navy crossover tunic, charcoal sash, tan trousers, wrist bracers and sandals. Make ONLY a tiny polite chin-down acknowledgment nod: lower the head and headband together about ONE logical pixel, keeping the original head size and width. Everything below the collar including clothes, arms, hands, belt, legs and feet must match the reference precisely and remain still. Preserve simple chunky LPC pixel shapes, palette, four-image-pixel hard grid and generous blank margins. No new details, symbols, weapons, text, labels, shadows, floor or ground. Transparent background. Preserve the reference canvas proportions 3:1 (768x256 reference); output just these three nod poses in one row. The nod is for opening a friendly dialogue, never an attack or spell.
